name: Collection & Lending Ledger
description: Track where your models, cards and board games are and how many you have; lend and return per slip with counts that always add up
help: Item details: name, series/edition, your own code, category, location, condition and notes. Same-name versions are told apart by series, edition or code. Owned = in hand + lent out.

Lend: choose the quantity, a borrower nickname, the date and an optional due date. You cannot lend more than you have in hand. Only a nickname is stored; contacts are never read and nothing is sent as a reminder.
Return: record a full or partial return against a specific loan slip, never more than that slip still owes. Slips and returns are kept as a complete history.
Before each action you see the quantities it changes (owned, in hand, lent, owed on the slip); it only counts once confirmed and saved. If saving fails you can retry without recording twice.
Undo reverts the latest step (add, edit, quantity change, lend, return, archive). Deleting an item and changing photos cannot be undone.
Owned cannot go below what is still lent. Items that were ever lent cannot be deleted; archive them instead once everything is returned, keeping their history.
The to-return view lists overdue first, then due within 3 days, then slips without a due date. Due dates are local markers only.

Export the item list as CSV or a full JSON backup with photos. Restoring can append (only new records; existing ids are skipped, never overwritten) or replace everything (with confirmation). All data stays in ToolForge on this device.
